name: 25-concave-copper-notch
purpose: Concave copper polygon with a notch crossing the trace
reasoning: One GND polygon is U-shaped: the copper top edge dips to y=30 between x=45..55. At the trace height y=40 that notch is copper-free but bounded by the same polygon on both sides, i.e. a void inside the copper rather than a different-net split.
